plain: Help your savings grow as fast as prices go up. Put your money in an account made to keep pace with the rising cost of living.
alt: Let your savings keep step with inflation. Switch your money to an account designed to rise along with prices.
frame_flip: Stop inflation from shrinking what your savings can buy. Move your money to an account built so rising prices don't leave it behind.
reordered: Move your money to an account built to match rising prices, and grow your savings at a pace that keeps up with inflation.
